_comment: Copy to owners.json (git-ignored). Maps the owner string a bank returns in accounts.ownerInfo.fullName to a person. Matching order: account_ids (exact, always wins) > national_ids > names. Name matching is order-insensitive, so 'Dana Cohen' and 'Cohen Dana' both match - but Hebrew and Latin spellings are DIFFERENT strings, list both or you will lose a card. A joint account arrives as one comma-joined string and is split, so every party gets a row. Run `openbank.py owners` to see every string the banks actually returned, add the unmapped ones here, re-run `openbank.py pull`.
